archetype: Swiss High-Precision Meets Field Craft (Precision Engineered / Industrial Warmth)

target_audience: Commercial field-service owners, operations directors, and founders across the US & Canada (inspection, testing, calibration, multi-location facilities & service providers).

theme_strategy.rationale: High-trust executive and dispatch operations feel authoritative, command-center clean, and eliminate glare for commercial operators.
